note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1936: nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., 28 April 1936. Party labels are not printed for the unopposed members. No nominations for Camly, Creggan, Drumbanagher, Lathbirget, Mountnorris, Mullaghbane, Poyntzpass and Tullyhappy, where the sitting members (not named) were automatically re-elected. Returned unopposed. John Reid: no party label printed in 1936. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Ballybot, 25 May 1933, printed 'U': Newry Telegraph, 27 April 1933, p. 5 ("Local Government Nominations: Newry No. 2 (Co. Armagh) Rural District Council"); Ballybot, 25 May 1939, printed 'U.': Belfast News-Letter, 27 May 1939, p. 9 ("Local Elections: Surprise in Armagh County Council Contest") ("Newry No. 2 Rural Council"); nominations from the Frontier Sentinel, 20 May 1939, p. 5).
